title: Minimum Cost to Connect Sticks

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def connectSticks(self, sticks: list[int]) -> int:
        import heapq
        heap = sticks[:]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        total = 0
        while len(heap) > 1:
            merged = heapq.heappop(heap) + heapq.heappop(heap)
            total += merged
            heapq.heappush(heap, merged)
        return total
